about: How Aico reads each subscription's usage. providers: the subscriptions it tracks, in the order the Status page lists them. lookback_days: readings older than this are dropped. reading_min_interval_s: a reading of the same window with no more use is kept only this often. late_after_min: a spend row goes late when no collection refreshed it for this long (the collect job runs every 5 minutes, see packages/jobs/data/jobs.json). unknown_after_min: routing reads every provider as unknown once the last collection is older than this (a few collection periods). native_homes: the homes whose Claude statusline snapshot, Claude Code transcripts (claude.transcripts under HOME: tokens per model and project, synthetic_models are skipped, remembered_messages is how many recent message ids a file's cursor keeps to count a streamed message once) and Codex session logs are read (~ is this user's home, a trailing /* is every folder under it; AICO_NATIVE_HOMES replaces the list). private_words: a home or working directory containing one of these words contributes only token and credit numbers (its name, paths and ids are never stored or reported). by_project: sessions of this provider leave a working directory in their logs, so its use is split by project (project_split: the last days counted and how many projects are named before the rest are folded into 'N more'). Paths: statusline is under XDG_STATE_HOME, sessions under HOME, key_file under the Aico data directory.
